function.name: generate_v_net_for_network_knowledge
function.description: This is the subfunction for tool "network_knowledge", you can use this tool.The description of this function is: "Generate a virtual network GML description based on user intent."

intent.description: User intent, usually in natural language

function.name: get_p_net_for_network_knowledge
function.description: This is the subfunction for tool "network_knowledge", you can use this tool.The description of this function is: "Retrieve the Physical Network GML file, which includes nodes (id, name, dpid, etc.) and links (source, target, port1, port2, etc.). This must be called before attempting to deploy a v_net, as the physical network state is required."

function.name: get_solution_for_network_knowledge
function.description:
This is the subfunction for tool "network_knowledge", you can use this tool.The description of this function is: "Retrieve a deployment solution for a virtual network. **Important:** The response includes:

   `node_slots` maps virtual node IDs(not dpid) **(key)** to physical node IDs(not dpid) **(value)**. \
    `link_paths` maps virtual links to **physical link sequences**. Always follow this mapping exactly. 
1. Before using node_slots, call 'get_p_net' to map physical node IDs to their corresponding dpid and name.
2. If any of 'result', 'place_result', or 'route_result' is 'False', deployment should be terminated, and the failure reason must be returned to the user."

v_net_id.description: The ID of the virtual network.

function.name: create_network_for_openvirtex
function.description: This is the subfunction for tool "openvirtex", you can use this tool.The description of this function is: "Create a new virtual network (OVXNetwork). Return {TENANT, CTRLURLS, NETADD, NETMASK, IS_BOOTED}, where TENANT is id of the virtual network"

function.name: create_switch_for_openvirtex
function.description:
This is the subfunction for tool "openvirtex", you can use this tool.The description of this function is: "Create a new OVXSwitch. Return {TENANT, DPIDS, VDPID}

**How to use:**
\
    1. Obtain `node_slots` from `get_solution`.
\
    2. Use `get_p_net` to find the corresponding DPID of the physical node.
\
    3. Ensure the DPID exists in the physical network before proceeding. If a virtual node already has a ovxswitch, do not create a new one. VDPID is the v_node's dpid(not v_node's id). You must remember the vdpid, so a complete node mapping is: {vdpid : v_node_id : p_node_id: dpid}."

tenant.description: tenantId. The ID of a virtual network

function.name: create_port_for_openvirtex
function.description: This is the subfunction for tool "openvirtex", you can use this tool.The description of this function is: "Add a new port to an OVXSwitch. Return {DPID, PORT, VPORT, VDPID, TENANT}, VPORT is the virtual port id corresponding to the physical port being added"

tenant.description: tenantId. The id of a virtual network

port.description: port. The port number of a physical switch port. You need to read the physical network descriptor's link information first to know the dpid of a physical switch

tenant.description: tenantId. The ID of a virtual network

src_vdpid.description: srcDpid. The VDPID of the source OVXSwitch

src_vport.description: srcPort. The vport on the source OVXSwitch

dst_vdpid.description: dstDpid. The VDPID of the destination OVXSwitch

dst_vport.description: dstPort. The vport on the destination OVXSwitch

algorithm.description: Method for setting routes in a OVXBigSwitch: "manual" or "spf"

backups.description: backup_num. Number of backup paths associated with a virtual link or route

function.name: set_link_path_for_openvirtex
function.description:
This is the subfunction for tool "openvirtex", you can use this tool.The description of this function is: "Add a physical network path to a virtual link (OVXLink). Return {LINK, PRIORITY, ALGORITHM, BACKUPS, PATH, TENANT}. "Add a virtual link using `link_paths` from `get_solution`. \
    Each virtual link must follow its mapped physical path strictly.""

tenant.description: tenantId. The ID of a virtual network

link.description: linkId. OVX-generated UUID of a virtual link

path.description:
The physical path taken by a virtual link or route. 

**How to generate:**
\
    1. Extract `link_paths` from `get_solution`'s response.
\
    2. Convert `{(v_id_1,v__id_2): [(p_id_1,p_id_2)]}` into `"dpid_1/port_1-dipd_2/port_2"` format.
\
    3. Ensure all `SRC_DPID/SRC_PORT-DST_DPID/DST_PORT` exist in the physical network."

priority.description: The priority (1-255) of a path associated with a link or route. Higher value is higher priority.
